patch_description:
This rewrite crossovers the stronger parts of the prior programs:

- keeps the efficient straight-line baseline from both versions,
- keeps deterministic candidate search from the richer version,
- reintroduces the more effective direct attraction-to-base term from the better-scoring simpler version,
- preserves local school avoidance with smooth Gaussian shaping,
- adds a mild end-of-path bias toward the base side so the curve naturally bends away from roughly `(40, 20)` and toward `(70, -30)` when those are the supplied landmarks,
- precomputes Gaussian weights to reduce repeated work.

Compared with the current program, this version is more conservative on unnecessary detours, but more direct in pulling the route toward the base’s actual Y-value. That usually improves the F2/F3 tradeoff without inflating F1 too much. It also keeps smoothing and soft clamping so the returned Y array stays smooth and natural.
